solutionSteps: Outer Radius (R) = 8 cm. Thickness = 2 cm, so Inner Radius (r) = 6 cm.

questions.question: A semi-circular sheet of diameter 28 cm is bent to form an open conical cup. Find the capacity of the cup.
solutionSteps: Sheet radius R = 14. Slant height of cone l = 14.
Cone height h = sqrt(14² - 7²) = sqrt(147) ≈ 12.12 cm.
